_seed_meta.description: Extracts budget line items from a proposal or award document, checks for arithmetic errors, and flags potentially disallowed costs.

items.name: Budget Analyzer
items.description: Extracts budget data and performs validation checks for common errors and compliance issues.

data.searchphrases: Senior Personnel Costs, Other Personnel Costs, Fringe Benefits, Fringe Benefit Rate, Equipment, Travel Domestic, Travel Foreign, Participant Support Costs, Materials and Supplies, Subcontracts, Consultant Costs, Other Direct Costs, Total Direct Costs, Indirect Costs, Indirect Cost Rate, Indirect Cost Base, Total Project Cost, Cost Sharing Amount, Number of Budget Periods, Annual Budget Amounts

cross_field_rules.label: Direct cost categories add up to Total Direct Costs
Total Direct Costs plus Indirect Costs equal Total Project Cost
Indirect Costs equal the Indirect Cost Rate applied to the Indirect Cost Base
Indirect Cost Base leaves out equipment and participant support costs

field_descriptions.Senior Personnel Costs: Salaries and wages for senior or key personnel (PI, co-PIs). If the budget gives one Personnel, Salaries, or Salaries and Wages line that is not split by role, put that whole amount here and leave Other Personnel Costs empty.
field_descriptions.Other Personnel Costs: Salaries and wages for other staff (postdocs, students, technicians) when the budget lists them separately from senior personnel.
field_descriptions.Fringe Benefits: Fringe benefits amount. Also labelled Benefits or Employee Benefits.
field_descriptions.Travel Domestic: Domestic travel. If the budget gives one Travel line that is not split into domestic and foreign, put that amount here.
field_descriptions.Travel Foreign: Foreign or international travel, only when the budget lists it separately.
field_descriptions.Materials and Supplies: Materials and supplies. Also labelled Supplies or Materials.
field_descriptions.Subcontracts: Subawards or subcontracts to other organizations. Also labelled Subaward, Subawards, Subrecipient costs, or Consortium/Contractual costs.
field_descriptions.Consultant Costs: Consultant services. Also labelled Consultants or Consulting.
field_descriptions.Other Direct Costs: Direct costs listed under Other or Other Direct Costs that fit none of the other categories.
field_descriptions.Total Direct Costs: The budget's stated total of direct costs. Also labelled Direct-cost total, Total direct, Subtotal direct costs, or TDC. Copy the amount the document states; do not add lines up to produce it.
field_descriptions.Indirect Costs: Indirect costs amount. Also labelled F&A, Facilities and Administrative costs, or Overhead.
field_descriptions.Indirect Cost Rate: The indirect (F&A) rate as the document states it, such as 25% or 56.5%. Leave empty if no rate is stated; do not divide the amounts to derive one.
field_descriptions.Indirect Cost Base: The dollar base the indirect rate is applied to, as stated. Also labelled MTDC, Modified Total Direct Costs, or base. Leave empty if the document does not state it.
field_descriptions.Total Project Cost: The budget's stated grand total, direct plus indirect. Also labelled Total request, Total budget, Total costs, Grand total, or Total amount requested. Copy the amount the document states; do not add lines up to produce it.

data.query: Equipment means acquisition cost capitalization level; Modified Total Direct Cost (MTDC) means portion of each subaward; participant support costs means; unallowable costs entertainment alcoholic beverages lobbying

data.prompt:
You are a grants budget specialist reviewing an extracted budget. Perform the following analysis:

Your input has three parts: the fields extracted from the document, passages from the Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200) retrieved for this review, each labeled with its source, and the arithmetic checks Vandalizer computed from the extracted values. Apply each rule as those passages state it and cite its section (for example 2 CFR 200.1, definition of Equipment). If the passages don't cover a rule you need, name the rule and say it should be checked against the regulation text. Never fill in a threshold, rate or requirement from memory.

## Arithmetic Verification
The checks below the extracted fields were computed exactly, in code, from the extracted values: the direct-cost categories against Total Direct Costs, Total Direct plus Indirect against Total Project Cost, the indirect cost rate applied to its base, and whether the base leaves out equipment and participant support costs. Report each one as computed. Do not redo or correct the arithmetic yourself.
- PASS: say it adds up, and give the computed figure.
- FAIL: report the difference the check gives as an Error.
- NOT CHECKED: say which value was missing or was not one exact amount, and that the check could not be made. Never fill the gap with your own calculation.
- A category counted as 0 because the document didn't state it: say so.
- A base that passes "leaves out equipment and participant support" is only consistent with those two exclusions. Whether other MTDC exclusions apply (for example, each subaward above its first portion) still needs the subaward amounts; say so if the budget has subawards.

## Compliance Flags
- Are there any potentially unallowable costs (entertainment, alcohol, lobbying, first-class travel)?
- Is equipment categorized as the 2 CFR 200.1 definition of equipment in the passages requires?
- Are participant support costs separated from other categories?
- For subawards, is only the portion of each subaward that the 2 CFR 200.1 MTDC definition allows included in the indirect cost base? An award made before October 1, 2024 may carry the earlier Uniform Guidance thresholds; check the award date.

## Reasonableness Check
- Is the fringe benefit rate within normal institutional ranges (20-35% typical)?
- Is the indirect cost rate consistent with the stated rate?
- Are travel costs reasonable for the scope of work?

Present findings as:
1. **Summary Table** - Budget category, amount, status (OK/Warning/Error)
2. **Issues Found** - Numbered list with severity
3. **Recommendations** - Actions to resolve issues

validation_plan.name: Cites the regulation it applied
validation_plan.description: Each rule, threshold or requirement the output applies is cited to its section of the Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200) (for example 2 CFR 200.1, definition of Equipment), and nothing is stated as a rule without a citation or an explicit note that the retrieved passages did not cover it.

validation_plan.name: Reports the computed arithmetic as computed
validation_plan.description: Each arithmetic finding (category sum, total, rate applied to the base, base exclusions) matches the PASS, FAIL or NOT CHECKED result Vandalizer computed, with the computed figure or difference. A NOT CHECKED result is reported as not checked, with the missing or inexact value named, never replaced by the model's own calculation.

validation_plan.name: Figures match the source
validation_plan.description: Every budget amount, rate and total in the output appears in the source document with the same value, unit and (for dates) year. A figure the output calculated says how it was calculated and the arithmetic is right. FAIL if any value differs from the source, or appears with no basis in it.

validation_plan.name: Allowability flags name the line
validation_plan.description: Every equipment, unallowable-cost or participant-support finding names the budget line and amount it is about. FAIL for a flag that does not identify the line, or a line flagged on a basis the budget does not show.

validation_inputs.label: Fictional budget with one planted error. Answer key: categories sum to $345,000 total direct (pass); MTDC base $300,000 = $345,000 less $25,000 equipment and $20,000 participant support (consistent); 50% of $300,000 = $150,000 indirect (pass); $345,000 + $150,000 = $495,000, so the stated $500,000 total is overstated by $5,000 (fail). Foreign travel and consultants are not budgeted.
